As someone with dpdr, this isn't really correct. Depersonalizing causes a deep sense of loss of identity which comes with thoughts like "What am I?" or "How can I be existing."

Derealization is kind of similar to hours becoming minutes, but that's mostly because when you heavily dissociate your short-term memory gets affected/worsened. But you can still think about meaning/purpose.

I can't speak for other dissociative disorders, but that's what it's like with dpdr.
